notes: The it of sent it is added: no object marker or suffix stands on the verb, and rule 44 refuses to fold a supplied object into the verb's unit.
in the house of Jehovah writes a preposition the Hebrew does not, so rule 33's adverbial accusative gives it to the construct noun rather than leaving it added.
the king's house divides under rule 29's possessive case: the article on מֶלֶךְ takes the left-edge the, since an English possessive takes the determiner of the possessor.
